text:
maria: Heads up — CI/infra alert: ~20 nodes in eu-west1 moved to OOB_MAINT after the BMC cert rotation job ran at 02:14 UTC. GPUs on those hosts are still attached to pods but kubelet marks node NotReady.
sam: :eyes: seen any customer impact yet?
maria: yes, a couple of long-running batch jobs got stuck waiting for GPUs. Queues ballooning. Customers reporting higher latency on async feature extraction.
pranav: Are the BMCs returning 403 on API calls? I saw some provisioning tasks fail with TLS errors in the agent logs.
maria: exact error from bmc-agent: "tls: certificate signed by unknown authority" when contacting management endpoint.
kelly: that matches the CSR rotation automation behavior if the new CA isn't distributed to all jump hosts.
ethan: Ops alerted earlier about a partial rollout — we set parallelism=5 for the rotation job but an infra-controller race meant some racks were skipped.
infra-oncall-bot: alert: eu-west1-oob: 19 nodes OOB_MAINT, 3 nodes OOB_UNREACHABLE, ticket INC-2321 created
sam: Can we pause the rotation and push a backfill of the old CA to the affected jump hosts? Or do emergency rollback of new CA?
maria: I tried backfilling via ansible to the top-of-rack jump hosts but some had key mismatch and failed handshake.
pranav: Quick triage steps: 1) identify affected rack list via `./tools/oobctl list --state=OOB_MAINT --region=eu-west1` 2) validate BMC cert chain with `openssl s_client -connect <bmc-ip>:443 -showcerts` 3) if missing CA, push cert to /etc/pki/ca-trust/source/anchors/ and update-ca-trust
kelly: If ops can't backfill fast enough, short mitigation: evict pods from affected nodes and reprovision onto healthy nodes to free up GPUs, then cordon the nodes.
ethan: Evicting will spike cost — we have to weigh against SLA. Current estimate: 120 GPU-hours queued; if we force-migrate, we pay for duplicated work ~60 GPU-hours extra.
maria: Customer-support flagged 2 enterprise customers at risk of missing SLA window — this needs priority.
pranav: Proposed immediate actions: 1) Pause CA rollout (controller paused) 2) Re-deploy old CA to jump hosts in the 6 failing racks 3) Run small restart of bmc-agent to pick certs 4) If step 2 fails, cordon+evict as fallback
sam: Who's on jump-host access? @pranav @kelly
kelly: I'll take jump-hosts for racks r12-r16. pranaV? (typo) @pranav you take r17-r21?
pranav: taking r17-r21. Maria, can you run the `oobctl` list and paste rack IDs? Also share the runbook link.
maria: racks: r12 r13 r14 r15 r16 r17 r18 r19 r20 r21 r22 r23 r24 r25 r26 r27 r28 r29 r30 r31
maria: runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/oob-bmc-csr-rotation
ops-runbook: Runbook note: if ansible push fails due to key mismatch, manual scp of ca.pem + `update-ca-trust` may be required; document step 3 for audit
sam: another concern — the rotation job logs show a TTL mismatch causing controller to reissue CSRs prematurely. Need to fix automation so parallelism respects rack affinity.
ethan: I'll open a follow-up PR on the rotation controller to add a per-rack lock and a dry-run mode. Tagging infra-safety.
kelly: quick commands I ran on r14 jump-host: ```ssh jump-r14
sudo scp ca.pem root@bmc-10.1.14.5:/etc/pki/ca-trust/source/anchors/
sudo ssh root@bmc-10.1.14.5 'update-ca-trust extract && systemctl restart bmc-agent'
``` worked for 3 hosts.
maria: After push, nodes came back to Ready but kubelet still shows pods in Terminating for GPUs. Need to force cleanup of zocket handles.
pranav: run `crictl pods | grep -A2 gpu` then `crictl rm -f <container>` for stuck containers, also `rmmod vfio_pci` on freed hosts if driver locked handles exist.
sam: :thumbsup: good call. Also let's add a metric alert for 'bmc-cert-mismatch-rate' to catch this earlier.
ethan: noted. i'll add an alert and an automation to pre-validate CA distribution before rolling.
maria: for visibility — opening INC-2321 with list of affected customers and estimated cost impact. tagging finance for GPU-hours estimate.
kelly: will coordinate with support to notify the two impacted enterprise customers and offer extended job time as remediation.
infra-oncall-bot: update: rotation-controller paused at 02:34 UTC
sam: timeline: 02:14 rotation started, 02:20 first failures, 02:34 controller paused, 02:46 partial backfill started, 03:02 12/19 racks recovered
maria: status 03:02 — 7 racks still in OOB_MAINT, working through manual push. continuing in runbook channel, will post a final summary when done. :fire:
